reportedProblem: Download Remotion failed even though all seven selected weights were installed.
causes: The tool helper used remote port8188 while the managed engine was configured on18189; the first queue check failed before a worker was created.
After successful pack installation, restart invoked system Python rather than the installed environment and failed importing yaml.

fix.endpoint: Read config/server.json and require a valid loopback host/port for managed readiness and all queue guards.
fix.externalCompatibility: An external engine with no managed configuration retains its read-only standard endpoint; installation still requires an owned managed process.
fix.errors: Surface bounded setup errors instead of the full SSH command/request traceback.

checks.laterUserGeneration: A separate user-submitted OpenJutsu video was running at Sample Video + Audio; no further setup or restart was performed.

limits: No generation-quality or speed benchmark was requested or performed.
The earlier failed setup receipt remains historical; current physical/node readiness enables Generate. It was not retried again during the user's render.
